name: candor-finance
description: Reach your money goals with ChatGPT. It plans from your real accounts, with goals that track themselves and a budget that pays for them, and every week Candor tells it what's worth talking through.

interface.longDescription: Tell ChatGPT what you want with your money, like paying off the cards or buying a home, even if you haven't worked it out yet. With Candor it builds the plan from your real accounts: goals with a pace, a budget that pays for them, and every charge sorted to match. Every week Candor reviews your records and tells ChatGPT what's worth talking through, like a goal slipping or a bill that went up. Candor never moves money.
defaultPrompt: Help me pay off my credit cards.
Where does my money go each month?
What should I know about my money this week?
